one_line: A shared-state learning roguelike for humans and browser agents.
what_it_does: Turns source material into branching study expeditions with quizzes, causal reasoning, adversarial dialogue, progress, failure, and recovery shared between learner and agent.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP directly exposes and mutates the same expedition graph and learning state the human sees; generic UI driving would be materially less reliable for branch and checkpoint state.
leverage_evidence: Four page tools are named: ingest_learning_material, explore_module, submit_solution, inspect_progress.
Packet says human clicks and agent calls mutate the same graph, room, checkpoint, branches, mastery, strikes, and failure state.
Description explicitly contrasts shared state with DOM scraping.
execution_rationale: The packet presents a coherent, unusually complete learning/game loop and live demo, but there is no submitted video or transcript and visual evidence could not be confirmed.
execution_evidence: Live demo reported alive and public repository is present.
Description specifies ingestion, study, cognition checks, branching, failure/recovery, and final boss semantics.
No video submitted; gallery image count is zero.
impact_rationale: Learners who want active, source-grounded study get a credible motivation and feedback loop rather than passive recall.
impact_evidence: Supports YouTube, articles, PDFs, notes, and uploaded text.
Claims cognition checks, causal chains, adversarial defense, mastery, and recovery.
creativity_rationale: The combination of roguelike branching semantics and shared human-agent learning state is a memorable, ambitious interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Learning is framed as runs with strikes, failure, recovery, skipped alternatives, and a systems boss.
Human and agent can take turns in one explicit expedition state.
usability_note: Conceptually clear, but end-to-end usability is not visually demonstrated in the packet.
red_flags: No video or gallery frames submitted, limiting execution verification.
standouts: Shared branching learning state is central rather than cosmetic.
Strong game-mechanics fit for repeated study.
advance_reason: Strong WebMCP-native concept and credible educational value; advance despite thin execution evidence.

one_line: A shared 3D desk-planning workspace where an agent discovers products and a human controls taste and approval.
what_it_does: Composes a miniature desk scene from commerce products, validates variants and constraints, handles stale edits, and stages an exact review before cart consequences.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP gives the agent precise structured access to non-DOM 3D state, locks, IDs, versions, and approval boundaries; generic UI driving cannot reliably preserve concurrent human edits.
leverage_evidence: Agent reads and composes a shared 3D scene through site-owned tools.
Stale calls are rejected after human constraint changes while locked and unaffected product IDs are preserved.
Digest-bound, expiring, single-use approval and partial-cart blocking are specified.
execution_rationale: The packet describes a coherent central workflow with concurrency, conflict handling, and consequential-action safeguards; no video was submitted, so observed completion is unavailable.
execution_evidence: Demo reported alive and public repository present.
Description covers initial request, human lock, agent proposal, stale-call rejection, refresh, replacement, review, and cart gating.
Accessible equivalent list and visible parcels are described.
impact_rationale: It addresses a real multi-product shopping problem while preserving human taste and preventing accidental purchases.
impact_evidence: Targets comparison, variant resolution, budget, availability, and cart-reproduction friction.
Example constraints include US availability and budget changes.
creativity_rationale: A non-DOM spatial commerce world with explicit human-agent ownership and optimistic concurrency is notably original and deeply pursued.
creativity_evidence: 3D desk scene is directly manipulable by both human and agent.
Locks, stale-call conflicts, versioned review, and partial outcomes are part of the concept.
usability_note: The accessible list, visible parcels, locks, and review gate imply strong usability, though screenshots/video are unavailable for inspection.
red_flags: No video or gallery frames submitted.
standouts: Exceptional treatment of shared state and concurrency.
Consequential commerce actions are explicitly bounded.
advance_reason: Transformative WebMCP use with a clear real-world workflow and unusually strong state correctness.

leverage_rationale: The agent can operate against editor, preview, and audit state in one tab, closing the build-to-a11y loop that otherwise requires brittle multi-tool handoffs.

Human confirms final settled price.

standouts: Negotiates the whole deal rather than only price.
